| |
---|---|---
| | | [Open in browser](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=69274999&utm_source=email)

# [A poignant anniversary](https://substack..c6kQWghfvVnQ8nTCdnuH-5jpDUHBrrEA_6pK4BG0jcU?)
### Yesterday was my mother's birthday. Her spirit was thankfully spared the future that she never had to witness.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/6e2cd41d-4f53-46d5-b8b1-b62dc8fbc3bc?r=1hvr60)| [Shahid Buttar](https://substack.com/redirect/6e2cd41d-4f53-46d5-b8b1-b62dc8fbc3bc?r=1hvr60)| | Aug 19
---|---
Yesterday was my mother's birthday. It would have been her 80th.
> One of the things I learned from my mother is that no obstacle is insurmountable. Her example is much of why I've always dreamed big.
We lost her to illness in 2016, just a few weeks before a federal election that--had the cancer not gotten her first--would have crushed her spirit.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4ceaba4a-4d40-45d5-bf1a-01d1be9192ea?r=1hvr60)|
---|---|---
I learned what that's like four years later.
### What I learned from my mom
[](https://substack.com/redirect/a34579ee-3622-49f8-ae0b-11c846a09e6f?r=1hvr60)
My mother spent the months before she passed away glued to cable news and the political party conventions, raging at Trump while prematurely celebrating the first woman in the White House. Mercifully, she died at peace, surrounded by her loved ones.
Her spirit was thankfully spared the future that she never had to witness.
Her illness took her from us within months of her diagnosis, and forced me to grapple with mortality. Her path to finding peace in spite of it inspired "[A Poem for Mom," ](https://substack.com/redirect/c792adee-610f-4a29-ba97-543bd00abb28?r=1hvr60)which I shared with her before she passed.
The poem has brought me solace when contemplating (not only her, but also my own future) death, and I've had the privilege of sharing it with others mourning the passing of loves ones.
[An audio recording of me reading it appears at the very end of this message. It is accessible to paid subscribers.]
Ultimately, my mother's transition beyond this life has felt like it brought us only closer together. When I cook, when I garden, when I dream, when I write, and whenever I teach, I feel her spirit moving through my hands.
One lesson I learned from my mother is that no obstacle is insurmountable. Her example is much of why I've always dreamed big.
She was not only a teacher, a gardener, an immigrant, a writer, and a grandmother, but also a visionary entrepreneur whose business ideas--including a novel approach to addressing indoor air pollution--emerged a generation before their time.
I take some inspiration from her ambitions, as well as her resilience in the face of her disappointments and frustrations. Her example makes the bitter pill of my neighbors' ignorance easier to swallow, and reminds me of the timeless importance of vision, whether or not it is recognized in its own time.
The path she followed, the example she set, and the lessons my mother shared with me each inspire me to speak truth, whether or not anyone's listening.
### Following her lessons
[](https://substack.com/redirect/c4e64fc5-81ea-4cde-abce-2475d0f7ddb2?r=1hvr60)
While my mother was thankfully able to find peace before she passed away, I have found it unfortunately elusive in the time since then. My awareness of the future has always loomed too heavily for me to lose sight of it in the present.
> My own spirit--and faith in democracy--were crushed in 2020 by the corruption that I ran for office to confront.
My mother's death was among the inspirations for my political campaigns. When I ran for office, my goal was to force change from within Congress favoring the values that she taught me to care about, like human rights, global peace, and the future that my nephews & nieces will inherit.
In 2020, with the support of 30,000 contributors and ultimately over 80,000 voters, I won the jungle primary in California's 12th congressional district alongside the Speaker of the House, becoming the only Democrat since 1987 to offer San Francisco a choice in November.
I overcame the challenges facing immigrants and working people: I overcame being unhoused in the early 90s; earned my degree after a decade in night school; worked my way to the top of the national non-profit community over a 20 year legal career; and set a generational record running for office against an intergenerational oligarch.
Then, just over three months before the election--in the ironic midst of a mass uprising across the world calling out the racism that pervades America's criminal injustice system--I become the target of [a public character assassination](https://substack.com/redirect/c679c8e3-99ef-463e-bc6d-2af4c381bcdb?r=1hvr60) enabled by the institutional racism of journalists across the country. The San Francisco Bayview, a national Black newspaper, later described my experience as "[a civic lynching](https://substack.com/redirect/72c910ca-fa79-4029-b640-019def44ec36?r=1hvr60)" witnessed by millions of people.
Every one of the many journalists who published disinformation about me between July and September 2020 betrayed their ethical commitments by silencing whistleblowers (including an elected Democratic Party official who stands among Black San Francisco's most stalwart voices), indulging the lies of unapologetic climbers seeking career opportunities in the Democratic Party, and ultimately, insulated the continuing self-serving corruption of a warmongering, insider trading tycoon.
Democrats who claim to care about democracy, human rights, or climate justice have no answer for the [documented](https://substack.com/redirect/34b41a4a-7dd1-446c-9e81-1235fb39e1c3?r=1hvr60) and [continuing](https://substack.com/redirect/b9e0e00d-1be7-43f4-b0e4-3a8f3f87bc7d?r=1hvr60) role of their party in [actively](https://substack.com/redirect/fc7d9956-c500-406c-a0b4-79378c09424a?r=1hvr60) undermining each of those values. They opportunistically reject the demagoguery of the GOP, while outrageously [parroting](https://substack.com/redirect/42e18b6d-f976-4a71-8096-879b736031df?r=1hvr60) it in broad daylight, relying on the ignorance of voters--and [complicity](https://substack.com/redirect/79af0856-c35f-47ba-bfed-2254b08dec7e?r=1hvr60) of journalists--to get away with it.
### Remaining unbowed
[](https://substack.com/redirect/9806b4d3-cf5c-4755-9e33-15b21bc40959?r=1hvr60)
While my mother taught me to speak the truth whether anyone else is listening or not, I'm grateful that you have been--and that we've stood together.**** My attempts to challenge corruption through a formal public process may have proved unsuccessful, but by bringing tens of thousands of us together, our collaborations shifted national policy, exposed a suppressed critique of bipartisan corruption, and created a chance for us to keep informing and inspiring each other going forward.
I'm also grateful for many other things: the tools to bring people together not only through politics but also through music and dance, the opportunity to escape electoral politics and leave that quagmire to others, and the one arrow left in the proverbial quiver of my congressional campaigns.
Last week, we filed [our amended complaint](https://substack.com/redirect/67114cd9-2fd9-4864-b3cc-4f6bb1d62023?r=1hvr60) in my continuing federal [lawsuit against the San Francisco Chronicle](https://substack.com/redirect/d40d37f7-5120-4091-8786-5174fe5105ac?r=1hvr60). The suit seeks accountability for the Chronicle's malicious and reckless publication of racist election disinformation fabricated to insulate continuing corruption in Washington.

I'll share more about the lawsuit--and how you can help support the racial justice, election integrity, and press accountability goals that it aims to advance--in a future message.
In the meantime, my next message will focus on a few creative projects, including some original music fusing documentary poetry, 4-on-the-floor house beats, and a rhyming analysis of international state violence and oppression.
Stay tuned!
### Thank you for reading!
[](https://substack.com/redirect/fbb8fd97-c118-4001-89f5-8859682a9d2f?r=1hvr60)
Getting off the political field has been a blessing. That transition has created space for me to further develop my creative voice, but leaves me no less committed to speaking truth to power, and no less grateful for all your help and support. **Thanks for being part of my community!**
Your friend,
Shahid
PS -- Got any thoughts or concerns to share? Whether you want to address my poetry and music, my critique of bipartisan political corruption, or our lawsuit guarding election integrity from racist journalism, I'm eager to invite your ideas! **Just reply to this email to reach me directly.** I'm also happy to share upcoming events where we can connect in person if you're in the Bay Area, or plan to visit Black Rock City at the end of this month.
PPS -- Below (accessible to paid subscribers) is an audio recording of "[A Poem for Mom](https://substack.com/redirect/c792adee-610f-4a29-ba97-543bd00abb28?r=1hvr60)." Whether you're mourning the loss of a loved one, or instead meditating on the fate we are all destined to share, I hope it might offer you some solace...

body:
********I 'm at my wits' end, Friend. Pelosi and the Democrats just have too much power, too many connections, and too much in their fundraising war chest. At this point, if I don't do a total 180 on the fundraising front, not only will I have to possibly SHUT DOWN my campaign, **_but Republicans may never win another race this year._** **Friend, this is Ryan Zinke. ## While Our Nation Was Burning in 2020, Wes Moore Said We Must 'Indict Systems' Because of '400 Years Back to 1619.'
Friends,
You should [watch this yourself](https://coxforfreedom.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=b45b281894&e=5bb5efcda7). Wes Moore, in discussing his book '5 Days,' where he writes about Freddie Gray and Baltimore City, claims that entire systems - including the police - must be "indicted". Read his excerpts below.

Baltimore City is 800 officers short - the BPD cannot even cover many areas in a timely way. And all across Maryland, officers are leaving our state because of the loss of the Officer's Bill of Rights. That is the real inequity. Far Left Democrat rule is literally causing public safety services to be denied Marylanders, who are being shot and killed every day. I have been consistent in my legislative and court defense career over 17 years of ensuring our police, and thus our communities, are protected. My plan will restore full qualified immunity, ensure the Officer's Bill of Rights is enacted again, and double pay to attract qualified and well-trained candidates. And my plan will empower minority and all communities to restore law and order and have a new birth of prosperity in family, education and business.

_I have five days to raise funds by our first reporting deadline of August 23. I need your donation help today_. Can you be part of the Freedom Circle of $350? Or maybe the Constitutional Council of $6000? Or maybe you can donate $100 or even at least $5.00?

Please [make a contribution](https://coxforfreedom.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=64e43f0101&e=5bb5efcda7) like our state and country depend on it because they do. We need to get this message up on air immediately. Three of the last five governors of Maryland have been Republican. Help me keep the office to restore freedom, law and order, and protect all of us.

Thank you. Let's win.

For Freedom,

Republican nominee for Governor of Maryland

In [this video](https://coxforfreedom.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=8ae6d2e4c0&e=5bb5efcda7) Moore claims:

> Salon dot com: "What is your view on defunding the police?"
Wes Moore: "...the budget for health and welfare in Baltimore City is like, what $42 million? And the budget for the police is $509 million? [Wes Moore laughing]..."So I just want people to have context on what we are talking about [regarding defunding police]...We are talking fundamentally about budgets and what budgets are, they are moral documents." (32:30 mark)

> "society pretends this [Freddie Gray's death] is brand new, but it's not brand new. Name a time when this wasn't happening..." (6:55 mark).

> "you know people think that there was just Freddie, but you know, in just the 24 months before Freddie there was Chris Brown, and there was Anthony Anderson, and there was Tyrone West, and so you saw how Freddie Gray wasn't an anomaly, Freddie Gray was a continuation when you look at what was happening within Baltimore..." (11:28 mark)

> that Baltimore City youth believe police "wake up every morning with homicide on their minds." (18:30 mark).

> "it's not enough to indict individuals, we have to indict systems. We have to indict systems. And those systems oftentimes exist because people have benefitted from the system....People think racism is an individual act. They're like 'I'm not racist...racism is like...I don't wear a hood...so therefore I'm not racist [Wes Moore laughs]. No you have to get out of that idea that racism is an act. Racism is a system. It's a system that...has been built for 400 years. Since the first ships that arrived on our Shores in 1619 carrying those who would build the lives and the labor...and what I want you to know about me, my words and my books is...if you really want to know what I think about history and all this, read this." (28:28 mark)

Since the 2020 election, they’ve taken numerous steps to undermine the foundations of American democracy. But we have a system to counter them. By donating to All On The Line, you’ll help fund our efforts to support fair maps, recruit poll workers, and support defenders of democracy. Even a $15 donation is crucial in helping us fight map manipulators and their system of voter disenfranchisement. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/firstthennow?refcode=20220823_AOTL_F_firstthennow] So, let’s lay out their system: First, they denied the results of the 2020 election. In states like Pennsylvania and Arizona, which were fairly decided, far-right legislators cast doubt on the results. Violent mobs stormed the Capitol for this senseless cause. Then, many state legislatures passed voter suppression laws. These include criminalizing giving food and water to voters waiting in long lines, restrictions on mail-in voting, and limiting the number of ballot drop boxes. Unsurprisingly, these laws have disproportionately affected communities of color. Now, some Republicans are supporting the “independent state legislature” theory in Moore v. Harper. If the theory prevails, state legislatures will be even more empowered to pass gerrymandered and unfair maps as many checks on fair redistricting will be removed. In the future, the far-right may deny the results of the 2022 midterm elections when they lose. They could continue to pass voter suppression legislation aimed at communities of color. And we fear they’ll become more violent as time passes. We’ve laid out their system, now we just need your help to stop them. body:
I’m not going to beat around the bush... Big Tech has become the censorship arm of the radical left. My team at the Center
[View this message in your browser](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z6vhgmssm39plj3c40s3o8nbul8knsuh9n94lgto_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jksrr0s3iekr79c9l6eon9d1hmej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfecbjm1qe9cr5e4r6fchhmirj2cjnmepbacbj69gn9ohheipmcsliedim8p5kcurt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or7m9o6ccln6dhmfdr3coon1cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn48d245p25oh4cdhm0p70cdgecpr24no)
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z34s3oclohsro9pkab6cif21q45m5p3qqgd04r28_rp22sh2s8i66or0cjg66o76cth2bs) Dear Fellow Conservative, I’m not going to beat around the bush... Big Tech has become the censorship arm of the radical left. My team at the Center for American Liberty has recently uncovered evidence of powerful elected politicians colluding with Big Tech corporations like Facebook and Twitter to de-platform and silence conservatives like you and me. **In other words, we’ve caught big government using tax-payer funding to silence their political opponents.** And if someone does not immediately stand up against this, the freedoms enshrined in our Constitution will become nothing more than meaningless words on a piece of paper. That’s why we launched a lawsuit against Twitter, U.S. Senator Alex Padilla, and a handful of liberal elected officials for their state-sponsored plot to eliminate our First Amendment liberties – _and we need your help to win._ **[Will you join us in our lawsuit against Twitter and Sen. Padilla and help defend the First Amendment?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z92jmqv6q644s88tairjtl10q7vr68j1i2673meo_rp22sh2s8i66or0cjg66o76cth2bs)** Let me explain... Like millions of Americans after the 2020 presidential election, conservative activist Rogan O’Handley took to Twitter to express his concerns about the dubious election procedures and skepticism of the results. [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zsoab4e843o741c4rnqfsm2dd5mdplfk9o46o4s8_rp22sh2s8i66or0cjg66o76cth2bs) [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zpoq3brjj9fark90oueqq271sis6h3b4go0k0cqo_rp22sh2s8i66or0cjg66o76cth2bs) [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zg624i4bqmscqc1tjs0i7l8g6vsfdjuh4svls8qo_rp22sh2s8i66or0cjg66o76cth2bs) Shortly after the election, many of Rogan's tweets were removed by Twitter and his account was permanently suspended for “violating the government’s rules about election integrity.” _Hopefully, I don’t need to explain to you that censoring or de-platforming ANY American for their political beliefs or opinions is a gross violation of the First Amendment._ But it gets much worse... When Rogan tried to figure out why he was censored, he found that bureaucrats working for then-California Secretary of State, Alex Padilla, had explicitly instructed officials at Twitter to silence him. You see, Alex Padilla was being considered to fill Kamala Harris’ vacated seat in the U.S. Senate – and he was afraid that Rogan’s tweets would hurt his image and chances of being appointed. **So, the office of Alex Padilla immediately instructed his press secretary to contact Twitter and shut Rogan up.** **From:** California Secretary of State Communications Department **To:** Twitter **Date:** Tuesday, November 17th, 2020 at 12:31 PM Hi, We wanted to flag this Twitter post: [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zold34itr2129eb3dviqoirvgmkob9oeakb00n4o_rp22sh2s8i66or0cjg66o76cth2bs) From user @DC_Draino. In this post user claims California of being a culprit of voter fraud, and ignores the fact that we do audit votes. This is a blatant disregard to how our voting process works and creates disinformation and distrust among the general public. Twitter then flagged the post as misinformation, deleted it, and -- a few weeks later -- permanently banned Rogan from the their site. [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z7te8i241le3l83d5dfab5m6s4mblfd7toctdt00_rp22sh2s8i66or0cjg66o76cth2bs) That’s why my team and I at the Center for America Liberty are suing Twitter, now-Senator Alex Padilla, California Secretary of State Shirly Weber, and a handful of other liberals for their involvement in this blatant assault on the First Amendment. But the only way we can take on the deep pockets and deep connections of these tyrants is with the help of patriotic Americans like you. [**Will you help us fund this critical lawsuit by sending a generous, tax-deductible contribution of just $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty today?**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z1h0fhoudtvdt0u2dihmklea2t6ma7rmbrogu6o8_rp22sh2s8i66or0cjg66o76cth2bs) My name is Harmeet Dhillon. Two years ago, I founded the Center for American Liberty with the purpose of protecting our First Amendment freedoms and civil liberties from being destroyed by today’s left. We’ve taken on Governor Gavin Newsom in California when he unconstitutionally shut down small businesses, banned people from going to church, and kept millions of children locked up in their homes—out of school—during the pandemic. We’ve taken on Antifa for viciously assaulting and nearly killing journalist Ando Ngo who exposed Antifa’s vile, anarchic plot to destroy the United States and turn it into a socialist utopia. **And now, we’re taking on Twitter, Sen. Alex Padilla, and others for colluding to eliminate Rogan O’Handley’s freedom of speech.** But as a non-profit organization, everything we do to defend our civil liberties is with the generous help of like-minded conservative patriots like you. And this massive lawsuit is expected to cost us over $1,000,000. _After all, we are taking a multi-billion-dollar company, the state of California, and a handful of well-connected politicians._ [**So, can I count on you to help us stand up to Twitter and Senator Alex Padilla by making a tax-deductible contribution of $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty today?**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zt0kj14nqgtpp0vbsk4lkj8pvkitgl3r48dkip1g_rp22sh2s8i66or0cjg66o76cth2bs) I’m not exaggerating when I say that this is the legal battle that will define our generation – and the future of our country. Will we sit back and allow elitist politicians, billion-dollar corporations, and faceless government agencies to continue to trample our constitutional freedoms? Or will we prove that WE, the American people, are still in control of our own lives? [**Please join us in this critical fight to defend the First Amendment by contributing $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty today.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zt0mlbk8urr8iftcrjj79kc00fbceeeth15o1560_rp22sh2s8i66or0cjg66o76cth2bs) Sincerely, Harmeet K. Dhillon P.S. For four years, leftist politicians and mainstream media figures would not let go of the bogus and unproven accusation that President Trump colluded with Russia to “steal” the 2016 election. But now that there is clear evidence that a California elected official colluded with big tech to censor conservatives who wanted to comment on the 2020 election those same leftists are dead-silent. I am absolutely fed up with left’s hypocrisy, double-standards, and blatantly unconstitutional behavior. [**That’s why I’m urgently asking you to contribute $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty to help us fund our lawsuit against Twitter and Senator Alex Padilla. **](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zaenhr1apfi0qaejvc10j2acgn7eh8dip169j5go_rp22sh2s8i66or0cjg66o76cth2bs) [**DONATE**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z33bci9va3pbeom6q090gn3jm202k9jv3ve2tsh8_rp22sh2s8i66or0cjg66o76cth2bs) [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zov7amndqtv8j0nsh67n3jj80vvg3rgntrm1ajr8_rp22sh2s8i66or0cjg66o76cth2bs) [Please consider supporting our efforts to defend our Constitution with a donation today.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zgqbup8jlo3jg1d4bvr015ma4bhd1lvnklh3b068_rp22sh2s8i66or0cjg66o76cth2bs) The Center For American Liberty is a 501(c)(3) charitable organization created to fight against growing anti-free-speech and anti-civil liberties trends.

body:

Anti-Americanism has long been evident in higher education. But
recently, it has spread from college campuses to other areas of
American life.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osyKUbIhhN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
fellow American,

Anti-Americanism has long been evident in higher education. But
recently, it has spread from college campuses to other areas of
American life.

Today it
asserts itself in many forms-including critical race theory-in
our government, in our K-12 schools, in our corporations, in the
media, in sports, and even in our military.

The
recent election in Virginia brought the corruption of American
K-12 education, in particular, to the forefront of our national
conversation.

The
breakdown (especially among younger Americans) of informed
patriotism-without which self-government is impossible-is not
something we can allow to continue.

While
there is reason to remain hopeful, there is much work to be done
to reverse the current trends in the months and years ahead.

Education
is where this attack on America began-and it is the battlefield
on which we must engage the Left in defense of liberty and
limited constitutional government.

Hillsdale
College has been deeply engaged in this battle for decades. We
are now determined, with the help of supporters like you, who
agree with Hillsdale's mission, to redouble our efforts at this
crucial time for our nation-no matter the cost.

That's
why we are expanding our Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by
Reaching and Teaching Millions in 2022.

You can
support this vital project through this link:
https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/preserve-freedom-for-future-generations

The
Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching
Millions will give informed patriots across the country the
effective ability to defend liberty through education. And we
need your help.

The
project has three key objectives:

Expand the circulation of Imprimis, our digest of liberty, to
reach millions more Americans.

Increase the number of citizens (especially younger Americans)
enrolling in our free online courses, such as "Constitution 101:
The Meaning and History of the Constitution," "The Great American
Story: A Land of Hope," and our newest course, "American
Citizenship and Its Decline" with Victor Davis Hanson.

Launch additional Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 charter
schools nationwide and provide, free of charge, our American
classical K-12 curriculum (including the new Hillsdale 1776
Curriculum) to thousands more American teachers and
homeschoolers.

And your
generous support is critical to our success. Here's why...

Hillsdale
College conducts its educational outreach efforts on behalf of
liberty-as it does all of its work-while refusing to accept one
penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of
federal or state student grants or loans.

So, to
expand this effective program, we will need thousands of gifts
between $25 and $100. This is the range in which most supporters
give. We will also need a significant number of $500 to $1,000
donations. But contributions of any size are appreciated.

We
urgently need your help.

You can
safely and securely renew your support using this link:

https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/preserve-freedom-for-future-generations

As the
forces of anti-Americanism redouble their own efforts to
undermine informed patriotism in our schools and our culture, and
to subvert constitutionalism in our government, we must engage
them ever more aggressively-including on the central battlefield
of education.

That's
why I hope you'll make your most generous gift in this critical
year for America.

Every
dollar you can give will help expand our Project to Defend
Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions in 2022.

Thank you
for your generosity. I hope you'll stand with us. Together, we
will work to preserve freedom for future generations of
Americans.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

I won’t lie: When I think about all the terrible things Ron DeSantis has done to Florida and her people during his time as governor, my blood pressure rises. It seems there’s no end to what he’ll do to advance his political career.
He signed the**most restrictive anti-choice legislation i** n Florida’s history since _Roe v. Wade_ , with no exceptions for horrible situations like rape or incest. It’s a monstrous law, but it won him points with presidential Republican primary voters, so he supports it.
Then, **he suspended a democratically elected state attorney** because the attorney dared to stand up to Ron’s unconstitutional abortion ban.
He’s vowed to **eliminate background checks and gun permits** across Florida, putting our children and our families in greater danger.
DeSantis signed legislation **targeting LGBTQ+ kids in the classroom** , further marginalizing already vulnerable students. We should be nurturing all of Florida’s future leaders, not tormenting them for political gain.
He’s determined to silence _anyone_ who opposes him. One autocracy expert recently claimed in Politico that **DeSantis is trying to turn Florida into his own personal “mini-autocracy.”** He’s even created an “elections police” unit that people fear will be more about voter intimidation than voter protection.
And now he’s **banning math textbooks!** Sadly, you can’t make this stuff up.
Suffice to say, the stakes could not be higher. With DeSantis eyeing a run for president in 2024, there’s no telling what he’d do if we don’t stop DeSantis and his agenda NOW.
**The good news: Floridians are on the side of decency — not extremism and hate. But we've got to get Florida back on the right track. Will you pitch in right now?**

name: Josh Shapiro
subject: Ron DeSantis in PA
body:
Hey Derek - you may have heard already, but Florida Governor Ron DeSantis will be in Pennsylvania today campaigning for my opponent, Doug Mastriano.
These two are working together to make Pennsylvania less free, less welcoming, and less democratic. Will you split a donation between my campaign and CommonGood to give us the momentum we need to win on Election Day? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_js?refcode=20220819_CGVA_JS]
Normally I don’t pay attention to what our opponents say about us at their rallies, but we all need to keep our ears open for this one. Ron DeSantis is coming to Pennsylvania to do one thing: boost Doug Mastriano’s extreme positions and beliefs to help him win.
Mastriano is a dangerous extremist who wants to impose an all-out ban on abortions — with no exceptions for rape, incest, or life of the mother.
Mastriano is anti-LGBTQ+ and wants to ban gay marriage. He even said “absolutely not” when asked if same-sex marriage should be legal.
Mastriano is anti-democracy. He wants to make it hard to register, vote, and request a mail-in ballot. He’s announced his plan to force all 9 million registered Pennsylvania voters to re-register — effectively disenfranchising huge swathes of the population.Look, Derek. Mastriano wants to take us back to when women had fewer rights, when the LGBTQ+ community was in hiding, and when people feared going to the ballot box.
I need your help to combat the dangerous rhetoric that Mastriano is going to spread across the airwaves in the months ahead. We have to organize, mobilize, and keep our ads on the air — but we need your support. Will you help us out by splitting a donation between our campaign and CommonGood’s campaign today? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_js?refcode=20220819_CGVA_JS]

Donate ANY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_js?refcode=20220819_CGVA_JS]
These aren’t times for the faint of heart, and that's why I appreciate the strength and courage of this team. Thanks for your support.

body:
https://secure.everyaction.com/DQ7Hxcpq3Eabel6LA-9V0Q2?refcode=newsletter [https://secure.everyaction.com/DQ7Hxcpq3Eabel6LA-9V0Q2?refcode=newsletter]
Remember , election day is fast approaching. Make sure you, your friends, and your family check their voter registration status! Here are some important dates to mark on your calendar:
October 24, 2022: Last day to REGISTER before the November election (Just 67 days left)
November 1, 2022: Last day to apply for a mail-in or civilian absentee ballot
November 8, 2022: Last day for County Boards of Elections to receive vote by mail and civilian absentee ballots (must be received by 8:00 P.M.)
Click below to register to vote or check your registration status.
Make my voting plan [bit.ly/NPPVotePA]
NPP In The News
Free Speech TV hosts an interview with Kadida Kenner [https://freespeech.org/stories/tonight-on-just-solutions-new-pennsylvania-project/?fbclid=IwAR0MXklAUHSuEyXUsM5mHYuFheQwAyEBynN8W5n5uWFVWHKPfV4wvB-Fsoc]

State and Local News
Republican Doug Mastriano challenges Democrat Josh Shapiro to 2 debates, but with conditions [https://www.post-gazette.com/news/politics-state/2022/08/16/pennsylvania-governor-race-mastriano-shapiro-debate-challenge-gubernatorial-campaigns-not-the-media/stories/202208160113] | Gubernatorial debates in Pennsylvania are usually hosted by independent media outlets and moderated by journalists and news anchors who have been covering the campaigns for months. Republican candidate Doug Mastriano has a new proposal and says he will only debate Democrat Josh Shapiro “if it’s a fair fight.” (via Pittsburg Post-Gazette) [https://www.post-gazette.com/news/politics-state/2022/08/16/pennsylvania-governor-race-mastriano-shapiro-debate-challenge-gubernatorial-campaigns-not-the-media/stories/202208160113]
4th Congressional Dist. candidate Nascimento airs positions at Gilbertsville town hall [https://www.pottsmerc.com/2022/08/17/nascimento-airs-positions-at-gilbertsville-town-hall/] [https://www.huffpost.com/entry/doug-mastriano-pennsylvania-gop-governor-candidate-secretary-of-state_n_62e4447fe4b0c60a5668334e?utm_campaign=share_email&ncid=other_email_o63gt2jcad4] | Christian Nascimento does not disagree with the renewable energy or the prescription drug price reduction goals of the “Inflation Reduction Act” President Joe Biden signed Tuesday night, he just thinks Congress is taking a patchwork approach that should be better planned out. (via The Mercury) [https://www.pottsmerc.com/2022/08/17/nascimento-airs-positions-at-gilbertsville-town-hall/]
Moving to open primaries in Pa. vetted by House committee [https://www.pennlive.com/news/2022/08/moving-to-open-primaries-in-pa-vetted-by-house-committee.html] | The House State Government Committee on Tuesday heard from independent voters, veterans’ advocates and Democratic and Republican operatives who all argued the state should open its primaries to voters who are registered independents. (via Penn Live) [https://www.pennlive.com/news/2022/08/moving-to-open-primaries-in-pa-vetted-by-house-committee.html]
Fetterman ‘grateful’ as he returns to Pa. Senate race [https://apnews.com/article/2022-midterm-elections-pennsylvania-campaigns-congress-fed5443cb4acc65365ee7403475b0099] | Pennsylvania Senate candidate John Fetterman acknowledged he was lucky to be alive as he officially returned to the campaign trail Friday, more than 90 days after the Democrat suffered a stroke that threatened his life and political prospects in one of the nation’s premier Senate contests. (via Associated Press) [https://apnews.com/article/2022-midterm-elections-pennsylvania-campaigns-congress-fed5443cb4acc65365ee7403475b0099]
Roe’s reversal puts abortion access on the ballot in Pennsylvania [https://www.penncapital-star.com/health-care/roes-reversal-puts-abortion-access-on-the-ballot-in-pennsylvania/] | Ashley Hoffman is currently pregnant with a girl, and she’s determined to make her future bright. That starts by telling the story of her daughter’s brother, “who was loved and lost, and whose mother lived because of an abortion,” Hoffman, a 32-year-old Bucks County resident, wrote in a personal essay she shared with the Capital-Star. (via Pennsylvania Capital-Star) [https://www.penncapital-star.com/health-care/roes-reversal-puts-abortion-access-on-the-ballot-in-pennsylvania/]
Josh Shapiro, Doug Mastriano race for Pa. governor puts partisan divide in clear view [https://www.post-gazette.com/news/politics-state/2022/08/14/doug-mastriano-josh-shapiro-pennsylvania-governor-campaign-race-election-messaging/stories/202208140061?oref=cspa_firstread_nl] | Circling the state just three months before the November election, Democrat Josh Shapiro and Republican Doug Mastriano — gubernatorial contenders hoping to take over for Gov. Tom Wolf — agree on one thing: The stakes are higher than ever, and they — not their opponent — can meet this crucial moment in Pennsylvania’s history. (via Pittsburg Post-Gazette) [https://www.post-gazette.com/news/politics-state/2022/08/14/doug-mastriano-josh-shapiro-pennsylvania-governor-campaign-race-election-messaging/stories/202208140061?oref=cspa_firstread_nl]
PSEA calls GOP gubernatorial candidate Mastriano’s school funding plan ‘completely irresponsible’ [https://www.pennlive.com/news/2022/08/psea-calls-gop-gubernatorial-candidate-mastrianos-school-funding-plan-completely-irresponsible.html] | Republican gubernatorial candidate Doug Mastriano has shared his vision for overhauling education funding that calls for directing dollars to students instead of systems. He wants to create accounts that would allow families to choose the best educational option for their child. (via Penn Live) [https://www.pennlive.com/news/2022/08/psea-calls-gop-gubernatorial-candidate-mastrianos-school-funding-plan-completely-irresponsible.html]
Luzerne County DA completes May 2021 primary election investigation [https://www.timesleader.com/news/1570110/luzerne-county-da-completes-may-2021-primary-election-investigation] | Luzerne County District Attorney Sam Sanguedolce and his staff have completed an investigation of complaints from last year’s May 18 primary election. (via Times Leader) [https://www.timesleader.com/news/1570110/luzerne-county-da-completes-may-2021-primary-election-investigation]
Want to help democracy? Sign up to be a poll worker in Pa. on Tuesday’s ‘Help America Vote Day’ [https://www.post-gazette.com/news/politics-local/2022/08/16/help-america-vote-day-poll-worker-sign-up-voting-precincts/stories/202208160048] | Inside Soldiers & Sailors Memorial Hall & Museum in Oakland on Election Day, every voter is likely to hear the same phrase: You are the only person today who will have touched your ballot. (via Pittsburg Post-Gazette) [https://www.post-gazette.com/news/politics-local/2022/08/16/help-america-vote-day-poll-worker-sign-up-voting-precincts/stories/202208160048]

---
| Hi Friends,
Happy Friday! Here are five things to know about Geoff and Leah's campaigns before the weekend:
---
---
| 1\. We got the signatures!
---
| With your help, the Diehl and Allen campaigns collected thousands of signatures to repeal the law giving driver's licenses to illegal immigrants -- way more than any other campaign gathered. Thanks to your volunteer effort, the ballot committee reports it now has enough locally-certified signatures to put the question on the ballot! However, the threat of legal challenges remains, so it's still very important to increase the signature tally up until the deadline. Click on the link below for more information.
---
| [Click Here for Petition Info](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0019ioJdbIgNCQUf2oVju4Zj5tH3DREQWkUDMTdyy7ig9Eegcy5oMf7uDO6_uWh6B0F1WM42LV3R8yf8pR51RLQmiggwRp4lqs_hCu70Hn80j-rocIy0ZCXianHR9u5254KXBNRTpkvqCGgV-sbP-IxpUOi1orwhPkQ&c=rPx9SPrTYyBi_2t8v7ZQmCspYht4mRETBCNtiuvUINjyyTEn_8iyTg==&ch=yGtFEwmymsnPo3yHXyUEyuneQ-9ign_w3seBI_rGnqlisTdoBCRypg==)

"Currying favor with a prominent conservative Republican in Massachusetts like Diehl is smart for someone who may have presidential aspirations. I expect Diehl will be the Republican nominee for governor this year. It'll mark the second time in four years that he earned the Republican nomination in a statewide race in the Commonwealth; he was the Republican nominee for U.S. Senate in 2018."

---
| Did you know that Geoff's candidacy is proudly endorsed by WEEI radio host Greg Hill? Well, it's true!
---
Endorsed By...

---
| There is nobody in the race for Lieutenant Governor who is more focused on protecting your Constitutional rights than Geoff's running mate, Leah Allen! She talked about her commitment to rights and freedoms in a recent video, which you can watch here:
---
| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0019ioJdbIgNCQUf2oVju4Zj5tH3DREQWkUDMTdyy7ig9Eegcy5oMf7uOZJYbNQNTFhoqlfrLBTCXIQzkIl8ZUsmhHtBsATM_a1NyeBXJ6lS6KVo14Dd0e9NZqXH_KJedL6BPInfyJ1r1uMQ5mx4fv1DA==&c=rPx9SPrTYyBi_2t8v7ZQmCspYht4mRETBCNtiuvUINjyyTEn_8iyTg==&ch=yGtFEwmymsnPo3yHXyUEyuneQ-9ign_w3seBI_rGnqlisTdoBCRypg==)

Friend,
This month, Democrats in the U.S. Senate delivered landmark legislation that will lower costs for Granite Staters and strengthen this country’s economy all while investing in the fight against climate change and taking on corporate special interests. The Inflation Reduction Act is a major victory for New Hampshire and this country.
But, folks, this victory was only possible thanks to the 1,017 votes that secured this seat in 2016.
That's right. I won this seat by less than half of a percentage point – one of the closest Senate races in history.
It was thanks to those 1,017 votes that Senate Democrats saved the Affordable Care Act in 2017, passed the American Rescue Plan in 2021, confirmed the first Black woman to the Supreme Court in 2022, and now, helped pass the Inflation Reduction Act.
**That's the difference 1,017 votes make.**
But because the GOP only needs to flip one seat to take the Senate, that 1,017 vote margin is also the reason Republicans see New Hampshire as one of their best chances at taking back the majority.
And they're not wrong. Political experts are calling New Hampshire one of the most likely seats to flip, and public polling has me down by 2 points to an extreme GOP opponent.

Hinson is unfit to serve. She says one thing in Iowa, but when she’s in Washington, she votes against what Iowans need.

**Liz supports the bipartisan Inflation Reduction Act for several reasons:**
* **Decreasing national debt:** The new law will reduce the federal deficit - by $305 billion. Every step to decrease our debt is good for Iowa. This is something the nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office knows best.

* **Fair taxing:** It calls for large corporations to pay fair and reasonable taxes.

* **Expanding energy production:** It invests in expanded energy production and clean energy to lower energy bills by an estimated $500 to $1,000 per year for Iowans. It extends the biodiesel tax credit and invests in biofuel infrastructure.

* **Lowering costs for seniors:** Under this new law, annual out-of-pocket expenses will be limited to $2,000 for Medicare recipients, and insulin costs will be capped at $35 per month.

**We need a leader like Liz Mathis who will PUT IOWANS FIRST. Can we count on your support?**

body:
We’ve been told our whole lives to eat lots of fruits, veggies, and whole grains to stay healthy.
However, according to Dr. Steven Gundry — a world-renowned heart surgeon — many of the so-called “health foods” in our diets actually contain a harmful toxin that could be expanding your waistline.
“This nasty toxin can rip tiny tears throughout your entire gut lining,” says Dr. Gundry. “This then allows harmful bacteria and waste products to seep into your bloodstream and wreak havoc on your body.”
**Today, new research shows this common affliction is currently affecting millions of people nationwide. The common warning signs include fatigue, digestive discomfort, weight gain, brain fog, achy joints, tired muscles, and sometimes even skin problems.**
“These common health problems are often mistaken as normal signs of getting older,” explains Dr. Gundry. “But I can assure you, the harm caused by this little-known toxin is far from normal.”
The good news is, this problem can easily be fixed at home.
“It’s very simple, you just have to know which foods are actually healthy, and which foods contain this hidden toxin,” explains Dr. Gundry.
By simply eliminating this toxin, he has seen thousands of his own patients achieve remarkable turnarounds. (In fact, he even lost 70lbs himself and has kept the weight off ever since.)
Now, after years of research, Dr. Gundry has decided to release a short video to the public — free and uninterrupted — showcasing exactly which foods you and your loved ones should avoid.
“Our health is our greatest gift,” he explains. “So if this video helps people look better and feel better, I’m thrilled to be of service.”
The video has since gone viral, first being shared by users on Facebook, then being featured on news sites like ABC and CBS.
So far, the comments and feedback have been encouraging, with thousands of Americans feeling better than they have in decades.

Peter, believe it or not, that's me!

Yes, it was the late '70s, and even I was not immune to the fashions of the day. But admittedly, I had some bigger issues on my mind (bigger even than my glasses): I was in my senior year at Fort Hamilton High School in Brooklyn, trying to figure out how I could truly make a difference in the world.

I kept coming back to the civil rights marches and protests that I encountered when I was younger. The Civil Rights Movement consumed the better part of my childhood, and it instilled a fiery passion for justice and equality in me from a young age.

My love for justice first started when I picked up a book on Justice Thurgood Marshall. Inspired by his story, I began to toy with the idea of law school. I knew that having a law degree would be a valuable tool in the fight for justice and equality, so I decided to pursue law school despite the high barriers to entry.
**I didn’t know that my fight for justice and my interest in law would lead me to become the first Black woman elected to statewide office in New York. But these aren't laurels I rest on: Every day, I strive to hold the powerful accountable and help families like my own.**

But Peter, I need your help to continue this vital work. **I’m up for re-election this November, and I have to defeat my Republican opponent to continue to fight as your attorney general for another four years, so please:

[Will you make a donation of $5 or more to my campaign now so I can defeat my GOP opponent, continue to hold the powerful and corrupt accountable, and fight for justice?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49450446/362209693/379053316?&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk647-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTg0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYTczZTY1NC1kMDFmLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nwh1h2xfP108DNLK1f7eL5hN3KrkGZ1UWQBxvXojAmQ=)**

Friends, this is bigger than politics.

I'm not surprised, friend. **Kevin McCarthy and the Republican Party are actively rooting against working families.** On Tuesday, Joe Biden signed the Inflation Reduction Act into law. This bill helps lower the cost of prescription drugs and health insurance. It also cuts the national deficit and invests in clean energy to curb the effects of climate change -- **all while tackling inflation head-on. ** From day one, McCarthy used inflation as a core issue for his reelection campaign. subject: Update: Sarah Palin House race
body:
| | | | |

| | | ***UPDATE: We've got results from the special election in Alaska, and the good news is, we can still defeat Sarah Palin. In fact, we've got two chances to do it. Here's the details (and remember to [help Democrat Mary Peltola](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta998481f-d1da-4994-9854-0689143070b1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) if you can, because Palin is a blithering idiot, and we've got enough of those in Congress already): [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T697a507a-a1e1-4121-8d3a-0f19756298e3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
* Alaska just held an election to fill the vacant seat of the late Rep. Don Young through the end of this term. There were 3 candidates: Palin, Democrat Mary Peltola, and Republican Nick Begich.
* The election was held using [ranked choice voting](https://default.salsalabs.org/T24207712-7db3-4b14-bdc2-b4a5bd69675a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), in which voters rank the candidates, the last place finisher is dropped each round of counting, and their votes go to their second choice until one candidate has more than 50%.
* With 82% of the vote counted, Democrat Mary Peltola is in first place, with 38% of the vote, Palin has 31.9%, and Begich has 28.6%. It may take nearly two more weeks to count all the votes, but if these results hold up, Begich will be dropped, and his voters' votes will go to their second choices.
* Still with us? Need more coffee? Go ahead, we'll wait.
* Okay, here's where it gets really interesting -- If Peltola gets a little more than 40% of Begich's votes, she will win. Now, normally, you'd expect a Republican voter's second choice to be the other Republican in the race. And yes, the odds are still with Palin, but... the battle between Begich and Palin was fierce, and many Alaska Republicans still resent Palin for leaving her job as governor half-way through, to run for VP. And Peltola's lead could increase as the rest of the initial votes are counted, meaning she'd need even less of Begich's votes. Bottom line -- stay tuned, this could be a nail biter.

But there's more!
* On the same day, Alaska also held a primary election for the _next_ term, the Representative who will serve from January 2023 to Jan 2025. With basically the same candidates, and with the top 4 advancing to the general election in November.
* Peltola is also leading in that race, by a few points, and will certainly advance to the next step.

Bottom line: Peltola could win now, she could win in November, and it's up to us to make sure she has the resources necessary to wage this battle. So dig deep, donate what you can, and keep the House Palin-free! [Rush a last minute donation now to support her campaign >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tef639f33-dcb7-43de-9ed6-6291b2940a64/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

She’s ALL-IN on Trump’s MAGA agenda – she was among the first to back Trump’s presidential run in 2016, and he immediately endorsed her campaign for Congress. Can you imagine Sarah Palin teaming up with the likes of Marjorie Taylor Greene, Lauren Boebert and Matt Gaetz?? We can’t let that happen! Thankfully, we have an incredible candidate running to defeat Sarah Palin. Mary Peltola is a Yup’ik Eskimo, salmon advocate, and Democrat who was a member of the Alaska House of Representatives for 10 years. With deep ties to Alaska, Mary can win and help us hold onto our House majority! A special election is taking place for this seat and it’s only a few weeks away. Mary needs our support so she can defeat MAGA-enthusiast Sarah Palin – and the polls show she has a real chance! Peter,
Did you see the big news?
On Tuesday, President Biden signed the Inflation Reduction Act into law.
Chuck Schumer describes the Act as "the boldest climate package in U.S. history" . The bill has been months in the making, and is a huge win for both working families and for climate justice.
Not only will the IRA help fight inflation and expand healthcare access, it invests nearly $400 billions dollars into climate action initiatives and green jobs, and it protects Pennsylvania Seniors on Medicare by capping their out-of-pocket prescription drug costs.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90471/images/999.png]
While Democrats in Congress were working hard to get this bill across the finish line, every single Pennsylvania Republican in Congress voted NO.
When Democrats were championing the needs of the middle class and fighting to address the climate crisis, Pennsylvania Republicans chose partisanship instead.
The IRA is a shining example of the impact of having sound, compassionate, community-centered people in positions of power.
Pennsylvania Democrats up and down the ballot are committed to making community investment a top priority.

name: NH Republican State Committee
subject: NHGOP Unity Breakfast
body:
New Hampshire Republican State Committee

| Derek -- **We are only 25 days away from the Republican Primary,** and our party is fired up! But once the primary is over, we all look forward to joining together to support our Republican nominees. I wanted to reach out and invite you to join me for our **NHGOP Unity Breakfast** on Thursday September 15th at 8:30am at the Grappone Conference Center here in Concord--with a special guest to be announced. I hope you can join me as we celebrate our Republican nominees as well as the hard work of all of our candidates these past months as we unite together to defeat the Democrats in November! We are excited to come together as a party and work hard to elect Republicans up and down the ballot.**The Red Wave** isn't just something that's happening it's something we're doing, and thanks to your hard work and support, this is going to be a great year! | [](https://www.nh.gop/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYom_5iV1ML7OCl3CFwBmGbNjKZaAH2-ytW-YVZkp_vDL6UGD_5K_GF0MgBeWn0Cagw&e=3b759f8f09083dafc3b676ab7322a136&utm_source=nhgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=unity_elliot&n=1 "Purchase Tickets Here") [Purchase Tickets Here](https://www.nh.gop/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYom_5iV1ML7OCl3CFwBmGbNjKZaAH2-ytW-YVZkp_vDL6UGD_5K_GF0MgBeWn0Cagw&e=3b759f8f09083dafc3b676ab7322a136&utm_source=nhgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=unity_elliot&n=1)

# [James Judge wins 4th consecutive poll, this time Pinellas County Young Republicans straw poll](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=8eafaa9c5d&e=00028e5542)
_James Judge remains the frontrunner in Florida’s 14 th Congressional District according to another straw poll conducted in Pinellas County._TAMPA, Fla. – Republican frontrunner in Florida’s 14th Congressional District primary James Judge this week won yet another straw poll, this time conducted by the Pinellas County Young Republicans.Judge won 60 percent of the primary vote, according to the poll. The primary election will be held Tuesday.“I’m grateful for the outpouring of support and elated to see the results of the Pinellas County Young Republican Club’s straw poll. At this point, I am confident we will win the primary election on Tuesday,” Judge said. “I’d also like to thank the Pinellas County Young Republicans for conducting the poll. Young Republicans in Florida and nationwide are the lifeblood of our party, and we need to do more as a party to ensure we’re reaching young people.”After Tuesday, Judge will face Democrat incumbent Kathy Castor in the general election, and says he is confident that he will win that election, too.“Florida’s 14th Congressional District will be the only truly competitive race in November in the Tampa Bay area, and I plan to do everything in my power to ensure that we flip this seat from Blue to Red,” said Judge. “It is crucial that voters come together to defeat Kathy Castor, who, like the rest of the Democrats, is spending money that we don’t have, hurdling America towards hyperinflation and causing skyrocketing fuel and food prices. She is also anti-Constitution, and an anti-Second Amendment extremist who has made our community less safe through her anti-police rhetoric and actions like co-sponsoring legislation to defund police.”Judge, who has led for most of the primary race, has won every straw poll conducted, including those conducted by the Tampa Bay Young Republicans, the Tampa Bay Chamber of Commerce, and the Brandon Chamber of Commerce.Judge recently earned the recommendation of the Tampa Bay Times, and has been endorsed by Congressman Paul Gosar (R-AZ), retired Republican Congressman Ted Yoho, Pinellas County Sheriff Bob Gualtieri, The Tampa Police Benevolent Association, Clearwater Mayor Frank Hibbard, the Community Patriots Tampa, Chris Chambers, a former Congressional candidate and community leader, and former SBA White House Deputy Chief Matt Becker, who previously ran for Congress against an incumbent Democrat in St. Petersburg.**About James Judge:
** Judge, who publicly announced his run for Congress earlier this year, is the only Tampa Bay area native running in the race, having been born in Clearwater, Florida. Judge graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and served in the U.S. Coast Guard in Operation Iraqi Freedom. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based PR firm and marketing agency with clients worldwide.Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner in Hillsborough County. The Judges are avid animal lovers and together, they have four dogs, three cats, two horses and 10 chickens. Judge is a proud member of the NRA, Veterans of Foreign Wars and the American Legion. The Judges are also active members at Idlewild Baptist Church in Tampa.

**Please consider me to represent you in Congress.**
Good morning, I’m James Judge, the Republican front-runner in the race for Florida’s 14th Congressional District and I am personally writing this email to you this morning. Will you please consider voting for me at early voting locations in Pinellas and Hillsborough through this weekend, or at your polling place in your precinct on election day on Tuesday, Aug. 23?**Here’s who I am and what I stand for:**
* Pro-God (Christian)
* Pro-Constitution
* Pro-Family
* Pro-Life
* Pro-Guns
* Conservative
* Operation Iraqi Freedom - Iraq War Veteran - U.S. Coast Guard
* Operation Enduring Freedom (Afghanistan) - U.S. Dept. of Defense
* Small Business Owner
* Not a politician - never run before
* Only candidate born-and-raised here in the Tampa Bay area (Morton Plant Hospital - Clearwater, Florida)
* There are only two genders: male or female
* Critical Race Theory should be banned

**Here are my top priorities:**
* Curb inflation, reduce gas prices, become energy independent again
* Drastically reduce the size of the federal government and return power to the states
* Eliminate wasteful spending, balance the budget, spend less than we take in
* Restore law-and-order and support our men and women in the military and in law enforcement

**My endorsements:**
* Tampa Police Benevolent Association
* Pinellas County Sheriff Bob Gualtieri
* Clearwater Mayor Frank Hibbard
* Congressman Paul Gosar (R-AZ)
* Congressman Ted Yoho (R-FL retired 2021)
* Community Patriots Tampa
* Roger Stone, Legendary Republican Strategist
* Tampa Bay Times: _“We view James Judge as the stronger Republican...”_

**Polling:**
* Tampa Bay Chamber of Commerce Straw Poll - **Republican Winner**
* Tampa Bay Young Republicans - **Winner**
* Pinellas County Young Republicans - **Winner**
* Brandon Chamber of Commerce Straw Poll - **Overall Winner**

At the end of the day, my race is the most important in the Tampa Bay area, as I am the only candidate fighting to take out an incumbent Democrat. My opponent has been in Washington, D.C. since 2006 and she is absolutely a major part of the problem. She co-sponsored legislation to defund police and supports Pelosi’s radical, far-left agenda. I am the only candidate who can take her out. Please support my campaign by voting for me this election. | **Hi Peter, welcome to my political newsletter where I update you on our campaign and my work in Congress.**

I have great news: my work in Congress has been paying off tremendously. My bill, the PACT Act, was signed by President Biden into law AND I helped pass the Inflation Reduction Act which was also signed into law very recently!

It’s clear our Democratic majorities and strong progressive coalitions are leading to real results for working families –**and we need to keep Democrats in charge in this election and beyond. Because if we let Republicans take over,_it would be disastrous._**

With you by my side, I know we will succeed. Please read on to learn more about our important work!

* * *

**PACT Act becomes law of the land**

**Huge update on the PACT Act:** I co-authored and led the fight to pass the PACT Act. And I am so proud to say we succeeded: The PACT Act is now the law of the land.

**This is the biggest expansion to veterans benefits in VA history.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49466917/362251202/452722638?amount=7&refcode=MTFC_20220819_EMDF_E1_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM2MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NWVmZGY3Zi1lODFmLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V_YnWnZTkPUz89-G6ZZgNuHxvwejb1fgu8j7L8FPoIc=)
I couldn’t be more proud and honored to have led this fight. This will mean so much to the millions of incredible veterans who served our country – and it wouldn't be possible without you, Peter. Thank you for being part of my fight.
* * *

**Inflation Reduction Act**

Just last week, **I voted to PASS the Inflation Reduction Act** , a bill of historic proportions that will make HUGE climate change investments, REFORM healthcare, and TAX big corporations.

President Biden has since also signed this bill into law! It’s incredible what Democrats and progressives can accomplish together. We must keep up these critical results for the American people.
* * *

**Official Congressional Delegation to Asia**

I was proud to join Speaker Nancy Pelosi, on an official congressional delegation visit to Asian democracies including Singapore, Malaysia, South Korea and Japan. **We even made a historic visit to Taiwan** to support their vibrant democracy.

It was my honor to strengthen relationships with our allies and discuss foreign policy topics such as economic trade, peace and security, COVID-19, climate change, and others.
* * *

**What’s Next**

Many people consider August a slow period, but I’m not letting up for one second. There is too much work to be done and too many people counting on us. **We must keep fighting for working families, veterans, and marginalized people across the country.**

So Peter, with critical midterm elections just eighty (80) days away, and Democrats projected to lose the House, your support is more critical than ever.

Friend, I want to share an example of how our voting rights can be gradually eroded over time -- and how we can stop it.
Across the country, states have considered almost 400 voter suppression bills in 2022. The most extreme measures are often targeted and defeated early on. But those extreme bills also make somewhat less extreme bills seem reasonable by comparison.
It's an insidious trick, and a deliberate one: Flood the zone with lots of anti-voting rights bills, and hope one of them sneaks through. Fighting back against this strategy requires constant vigilance -- and that's where we need your help.

All On The Line understands that our democracy is fragile, and that strengthening it will require us to go to work at the polls, in the courts, and in statehouses across the country.
Organizing, litigating, and getting out the vote is never easy, and there are plenty of folks who want to make it even harder for the voices of ordinary people to be heard. But history also teaches us that the best -- and maybe the only -- way to respond to those trying to weaken our democracy is to join together, work together, and fight back together.
All On The Line is working to amplify your voice and strengthen our democracy -- and thanks to supporters like you we’ve made a lot of progress. But we can’t stop now. Not when voting rights are on the line.

But history also teaches us that the best -- and maybe the only -- way to respond to those trying to weaken our democracy is to join together, work together, and fight back together. disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:

_Gabby and me during her recovery_
Friends —
When I think about the toughest times in my life, I’m thankful I’ve always had a support system around me to help me through.
Being raised by two working parents who sometimes struggled to make ends meet wasn’t always easy.
Flying combat missions in Desert Storm wasn’t easy.
Watching Gabby fight so hard in the early days, weeks, and months of her recovery wasn’t easy.
Running for the U.S. Senate and having Donald Trump and National Republicans relentlessly attack me personally — that hasn’t been easy either.
But as a kid, I had my brother Scott.
In combat, I had my wingmen.
With Gabby, we had our whole community offering support.
And in these campaigns, I have you.
I could not do this without you. You probably didn't wake up this morning thinking you’d make a donation to my campaign, but I really need you if we’re going to defeat our Republican opponent and hold this seat.
[**Please, can you make your first $3 contribution to my re-election campaign before our August fundraising deadline ends? # [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49468592/362257683/-707005773?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwN2NhYWViOC1lYTFmLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9RG0pbKypnpwetABDQzk96kfvv_FKP_722RuNVuSqPU=)
Peter,

On Wednesday, we held our very first Town Hall in Wildomar, CA. The turnout was incredible, and I want to give a huge thank you to everyone who attended -- _including those who joined us online!_

**[You can watch the full recording of the Town Hall here>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49468593/362257686/-1336137734?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwN2NhYWViOC1lYTFmLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9RG0pbKypnpwetABDQzk96kfvv_FKP_722RuNVuSqPU=&emci=5310c373-d51f-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=07caaeb8-ea1f-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=12636851)**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49468595/362257687/192312732?refcode=em-8.19.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwN2NhYWViOC1lYTFmLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9RG0pbKypnpwetABDQzk96kfvv_FKP_722RuNVuSqPU=)
This campaign is about hearing from (and speaking to) voters in this community about the issue we face. I got the chance to hear from so many. One attendee -- Hydee -- asked me an important question I receive often, so I wanted to elaborate on my response with you today:
_“How exactly will you tackle the problem we have with corruption and politics?”_
**1\. I will support a constitutional amendment to reverse _Citizens United_.** Due to the _Citizens United v. FEC_ ruling, big corporations have more influence than ever. They are seen as people under the law and, therefore, able to spend unlimited amounts in elections as a form of protected speech. I think it’s dead wrong and has broken our politics. That’s also why I’m proud to be endorsed by End Citizens United.

**2\. I believe that all lawmakers should reject corporate PAC money.** I plan to honor that pledge because we’ve seen how dangerous it is when deep-pocketed interests speak louder than the people.

**3\. I will vote to ban Members of Congress from trading stock while serving in Congress.** This is a no-brainer in my view. If you’re making the rules, you can’t be allowed to write them in a way that benefits your own wallet.

This question is important here in CA-41. At one point, my opponent Ken Calvert was literally listed as one of **“The Most Corrupt Members Of Congress”** by _Business Insider_. Long before Trump’s run-in with the FBI, it was Calvert who was being investigated for buying land and selling it at an 80% markup after his earmarks increased its value.

**[This is a grassroots campaign funded by individual donors. If you can, I hope you’ll consider chipping in $3 to help us keep our momentum going.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49468597/362257689/192312732?refcode=em-8.19.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwN2NhYWViOC1lYTFmLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9RG0pbKypnpwetABDQzk96kfvv_FKP_722RuNVuSqPU=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ ******** | | | [Chip in $10 Now](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49468600/362257691/192312732?refcode=em-8.19.22-all-a&express_lane=true&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwN2NhYWViOC1lYTFmLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9RG0pbKypnpwetABDQzk96kfvv_FKP_722RuNVuSqPU=)

clean_body: | = Peter, On Wednesday, we held our very first Town Hall in Wildomar, CA. The turnout was incredible, and I want to give a huge thank you to everyone who attended -- including those who joined us online! = This campaign is about hearing from (and speaking to) voters in this community about the issue we face. I got the chance to hear from so many. One attendee -- Hydee -- asked me an important question I receive often, so I wanted to elaborate on my response with you today: “How exactly will you tackle the problem we have with corruption and politics?” 1\. I will support a constitutional amendment to reverse Citizens United. Due to the Citizens United v. FEC ruling, big corporations have more influence than ever. They are seen as people under the law and, therefore, able to spend unlimited amounts in elections as a form of protected speech. I think it’s dead wrong and has broken our politics. That’s also why I’m proud to be endorsed by End Citizens United. 2\. I believe that all lawmakers should reject corporate PAC money. I plan to honor that pledge because we’ve seen how dangerous it is when deep-pocketed interests speak louder than the people. 3\. I will vote to ban Members of Congress from trading stock while serving in Congress. This is a no-brainer in my view. If you’re making the rules, you can’t be allowed to write them in a way that benefits your own wallet. This question is important here in CA-41. At one point, my opponent Ken Calvert was literally listed as one of “The Most Corrupt Members Of Congress” by Business Insider. clean_body: We had to pull our ads off the air yesterday, so Raphael Warnock has the airwaves to himself in the race that will determine control of the Senate. | Fellow American, I had hoped it wouldn't come to this, but I'd prefer to be the one to tell you rather than let the Democrats leak the news to the mainstream media. As a result of the tough fundraising environment Republicans are seeing across the nation, we're not raising enough money to run the campaign that we need to be running. That means we've had to make some hard decisions. Yesterday we made the toughest call we've had to make since last August. We don't have enough money in the bank to keep our TV ads on air. As of yesterday morning, our ads are no longer running across Georgia. Meanwhile, our opponent Raphael Warnock has more cash than he knows what to do with. He has more than $22 million in the bank and is raising MILLIONS MORE each WEEK. While our campaign doesn't have the money to keep our ads running, Raphael Warnock could run ads for the next 11 weeks without raising another dollar. I need your help. The more money we raise today, the sooner we can get back on the air. It takes $2 million per week to run TV ads across Georgia. This might seem like a big number - and it is - I am counting on you, Fellow American. Thank you, Herschel Walker | | PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC. Don't want to receive any more of our emails? *Some photos I wanted to share

Team –

The most rewarding thing about this campaign has been meeting countless people all across our city. I’ve traveled many miles over the last couple of months, connecting face-to-face with Angelenos from all walks of life.

Many of these conversations shared a similar theme – people believe we need to move this city **FORWARD**. We need a mayor who will take decisive and bold action to tackle climate change, the homelessness crisis, and a stagnant economy.

clean_body: Some photos I wanted to share Team – The most rewarding thing about this campaign has been meeting countless people all across our city. I’ve traveled many miles over the last couple of months, connecting face-to-face with Angelenos from all walks of life. Many of these conversations shared a similar theme – people believe we need to move this city FORWARD. We need a mayor who will take decisive and bold action to tackle climate change, the homelessness crisis, and a stagnant economy. ** I’ve received endorsements over the past couple of months that I’m very proud to share with you all. That list consists of national leaders including President Joe Biden & Vice President Kamala Harris, Hillary Clinton, U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren, Dolores Huerta, and local leaders like U.S. Senator Alex Padilla, Rep. Tony Cárdenas, L.A. City Council President Nury Martinez, and Assemblymember Luz Rivas. I’ve also been endorsed by the Coalition for Humane Immigrant Rights of Los Angeles (CHIRLA) Action Fund, the Los Angeles County Democratic Party, and the LA County Federation of Labor. I’ve also had the privilege and pleasure of visiting several small businesses in L.A. At Sirens Java and Tea in San Pedro, we spoke about protecting small businesses and ending homelessness. Eso Won Books, one of the premier Black-owned bookstores in L.A., announced that it would close at the end of the year. That hit us hard, so I brought more than 50 community members to show support for this staple of the community. Just last week, I took part in the 1st Annual Nikkei Celebration in Boyle Heights, honoring Japanese American culture and history in L.A. I also found the time to enjoy some delicious tacos at the 13th Annual Boyle Heights Taco Festival! From Northridge to Highland Park, from San Pedro to Mar Vista – the people of Los Angeles have been showing love for their city, sharing their stories with me, and their visions for the future of L.A. clean_body: Help us keep the voice of your community strong. = Did you know that Tuesday was National Poll Worker Recruitment Day? This is a day of action to assist poll worker recruitment efforts in communities across the country. In the spirit of National Poll Worker Recruitment Day, we want to recognize the great work of our current poll workers and encourage people to become poll workers in our upcoming November election! Maggie’s campaign is ramping up ahead of November’s election, and we need your help. There's so many reasons to become a poll worker. You help empower your community by helping them vote, you learn about New Mexico's gold-standard election processes, and you can even get paid for your help! Poll workers are our neighbors, family, and coworkers, and their service to our community deserves to be celebrated. We have a lot to fight for in November. Without help from people like you, our citizen-driven democracy and elections would not be possible. Thank you, Team MTO Maggie Toulouse Oliver serves the state of New Mexico as Secretary of State, where she is dedicated to fighting for clean and fair elections devoid of dark money and outside influence. She's up for re-election in 2022, and we need to start building our grassroots movement to keep her seat safe. Help Maggie protect our elections system and create a stronger democracy! name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: A historic opportunity
body:
In 1973, the U.S. Supreme Court decided the case Roe v. Wade. And since that day, more than 63 million babies have been killed through abortion in our country. [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6968%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=v%2fY0Z9eVGnmOXUSdC6xlvA&sysid=1)
|
---
| | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Hello, In 1973, the U.S. Supreme Court decided the case Roe v. Wade. And since that day, more than 63 million babies have been killed through abortion in our country. It was the most destructive ruling in the history of our nation. And it led to an anti-life ideology that still infects America to this day. From what I’ve been told, you are someone who values and respects life in all its stages, and I’m guessing this makes you sick to your stomach just like it does to me. But the tide is changing, and that’s why I asked if I could send you this email today. [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c73217%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wQXoAxX%2b78lVXVTFTKFkng&sysid=1)[](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c73218%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wF33PptrOqXi63OnSqL72Q&sysid=1)
_Dr. Ben Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute_ The U.S. Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe gives us a historic opportunity to rebuild a culture of life. The battle for life has returned to the states. And we have a lot of work to do. Because the laws and needs of each state vary, it will take a supercharged effort to fight for the protection of the unborn. But the American Cornerstone Institute is committed to providing resources to support pro-life efforts in each state. And that’s why we need YOU! **Will you help rebuild a culture of life in states across America by making a tax-deductible gift today?** We have seen that the opposition is more hostile than ever now that the official decision has come down. We got a glimpse at those who are anti-life have reacted since the leak was made public. That’s why we’re asking you to give right now to help us fight back to protect life for the unborn with every tool at our disposal. So, please don’t wait. You can make your tax-deductible gift to protect life in states across America using this secure link: **[https://secure.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-states-confirmation](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c73219%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2fWHFUHKhIATNy26245U8Bg&sysid=1)** Thank you so much for any support you can offer. Regards,
Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49469732/362261843/812264984?refcode=EM_FR_220819WhatUnitesUs_N_MK_90DO_5_G_N_TESTA_logo_&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTY1NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZTY4ZTQxMC1lZjFmLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SkFlzCGTVHnC0Bz43QYN9FZPm_keA8ik0W8ovNQIXkE=) The things that divide us have been getting way too much airtime of late. It has been my privilege to represent my friends and neighbors in Ohio’s 9th Congressional district. This is a working-class district, and proud of it. Here we work hard, we’re union strong, and we look out for one another. Our family’s story could be anyone’s in the Ninth: my grandparents were all Polish immigrants, dad ran a small family grocery, and mom worked in a spark plug factory. My brother and I learned the value of a dollar, and of a loving community, from a very early age. This community raised me, educated me, and chose me to represent all of us in Congress. The national GOP is dead-set on handing over this district to an extremist who called for secession. Our opponent doesn’t represent this community, or America.
